STAT1 is not a component of the IFN-beta enhanceosome (IRF3/7, NF-kB p50/p65, ATF2/c-Jun, HMGA1). Its indirect influence runs through IRF7 induction, and Irf7 is already a separate regulator, so a direct edge would also double-count that loop. The two databases disagree 1-1 on the sign, which is what one expects when there is no direct edge to sign.
